_about: The Pre-production PATH: the order a film is made ready to shoot, one step at a time, the way the Story path is. Read by src/lib/preprod-path.js (which DERIVES each step's state from the scene model and its neighbours — nothing here is stored), src/pages/preprod.js (the path page) and src/ui/path-bar.js (the same strip, above every pre-production tool). A step is { id, group, label, about, tool, pages, only }. `group` is the heading the step sits under in the page's side menu (src/ui/section-menu.js); steps with the same group share one heading. `tool` is where the work is done. `pages` lists the page files (and, after a '#', the fragments) that belong to the step, so a tool page can light its own step. `only: "songs"` shows the step only when the film has songs. `module` names the plan-matrix module the step's tool is; a step whose module is off for every plan (src/lib/plan-gate.js isDisabledEverywhere) is left out, or its button would land on a page that says Not available. Ids are not storage keys; they appear in the address bar of preprod.html (#<id>), so do not rename one without a redirect in preprod.js.

steps.label: Lock the screenplay
steps.about: A finished draft with its scene numbers locked, so everything built from it keeps its numbers.

steps.label: Scene list
steps.about: Every scene once: where it happens, INT or EXT, day or night, and how long.

steps.label: Break it down
steps.about: Tag the cast, props, wardrobe and vehicles in each scene. Every report builds itself from these tags.

steps.label: Vision & look
steps.about: A lookbook: the frames, colours and references the whole crew will see the film through.

steps.label: Shots & storyboard
steps.about: How each scene will be covered: the shot list, and the storyboard where a picture helps.

steps.label: Cast & Crew
steps.about: Who plays whom and who runs each department, with a way to reach them.

steps.label: Locations & recce
steps.about: Where it is shot: addresses, recce notes, and permission asked for and given.

steps.label: Songs
steps.about: A song shot as a block still needs scenes, days and a place like any other unit.

steps.label: Budget
steps.about: What it costs, line by line, against what you have.

steps.label: Schedule
steps.about: Scenes onto shoot days, days onto dates: the stripboard and the day out of days.

steps.label: Sides & call sheets
steps.about: The pages the unit actually reads: each day's sides and its call sheet.

steps.label: Ready to shoot
steps.about: Everything above, checked together: what still stops a day, and what you will regret.
